title: EAS-Sim: A Framework and its Methodology for the Co-Design of Multi-Objective, Energy-Aware Schedulers for AI Clusters
problem: Energy consumption is a critical operational cost in DL cluster datacenters, but schedulers ignore energy objectives
motivation: Modern HPC datacenters need multi-objective schedulers balancing performance, fairness, QoS, and energy efficiency
method: EAS-Sim framework + methodology for co-designing energy-aware schedulers: Zeus (energy), Hades (fairness), AuraChronos (SLA), Charon (power budget)
key_novelty: Systematic methodology for co-designing multi-objective, energy-aware schedulers with simulation framework
